services.desc: Capture Unforgettable Views of Toronto - A Scenic Cruise Offering Stunning Photo Ops of the City Skyline, Island Wildlife, and Waterfront Landmarks Your tour begins with an up-close look at Toronto’s vibrant western Harbourfront. From there, you’ll cross the harbour into the tranquil lagoons of the Toronto Islands, venturing into the heart of the archipelago. Highlights include historic Hanlan’s Point, the Island Yacht Club, and the serene woodlands of the Island Bird and Wildlife Sanctuary-keep an eye out for native birds, beavers, and even white-tailed deer. As we continue deeper into the islands, you’ll enjoy peaceful views of the island’s green spaces while cruising along Long Pond,

blurb: Guests can enjoy sightseeing cruises with live narration, explore the Toronto Islands, and take water taxis for quick access to the islands. Private charters offer custom-curated tours tailored to guests' interests and pace. The fleet is certified and has over 25 years of experience providing safe and comfortable departures from Pier 6.
